scope: 352 repositories returned by gh repo list hyperpolymath --limit 2000; all visible entries public and non-archived
notes: Tree completeness is not semantic completeness.
Nested projects and templates are candidates, not automatically root policy.
Human review was selective; retrieved content is not necessarily interpreted.
GitHub enumeration cannot establish the absence of inaccessible/private repositories.
Local working-branch quarantine differs from the remote gitbot-fleet revision.
